newsitem.title: USA: Om Group files for three millon common.
newsitem.headline: Om Group files for three millon common.

text.p: OM Group Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to three million common shares.
OM has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 450,000 additional shares. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 21,617,914 common.
The offering will be made through Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, Merrill Lynch & Co and First Analysis Securities Corp.
Net proceeds will be used to reduce indebtedness incurred in the acquisition of SCM Metal Products Inc, OM said.
OM, based in Cleveland, Ohio, is a producer and international marketer of value-added, metal based specialty chemicals and powders.
